line_evidence.text: A4.3.10 Explain the importance of model selection and comparison in machine learning.
• How different algorithms can yield different results depending on the data and type of problem
• The reasons for selecting specific machine learning models over others, considering factors like the
nature of the problem, its complexity and desired outcomes
• The variability in algorithm performance based on the data’s characteristics
